game.name: sokoban-solver-generator
game.description: Open-source pygame Sokoban with text level files (levels/*.dat)

level_format.layout: one row per line, tokens separated by spaces, all rows the same length

skills.label: Box pushing
skills.definition: A box is pushed during the solution.

skills.label: Planning with several boxes
skills.definition: Two or more boxes that start off a goal must be delivered.
